title: ProPELL Survey Codebook
text:
Survey Organization
The ProPELL study comprises 25 surveys administered over a 21-week study period:

s00 – Screening survey (online)
s01–s21 – Weekly surveys during the 21-week study

Surveys with suffix o = completed online from home
Surveys with suffix l = completed on-site in the laboratory



Example: Survey s08o = Week 8, online completion | Survey s12l = Week 12, on-site lab completion

title: ProPELL Survey Codebook
text:
Survey Names
The surveys in this codebook are named after the week in which they were collected: s00 represents the screening survey prior to the study and s01 to s21 represent the surveys during the 21 weeks of the study. The suffix indicates whether the questionnaire was completed on site in the laboratory (i.e., l) or online from home (i.e., o). For example, participants completed survey s08o online in Week 8.
The survey data are available as individual datasets in the ProPELL Data Hub. They can be joined as necessary using the anonymous participant IDs.

title: ProPELL Survey Codebook
text:
Anonymized Participant IDs
The participant IDs in these datasets are anonymized, as the code generated by the participants during the study (e.g., IKTENT20) only allows for pseudonymized data.
The mapping of anonymous and pseudonymous IDs is available here (only authorized PIs; requires login).

title: ProPELL Survey Codebook
text:
Variable Naming Convention
Each variable has a prefix indicating when it was assessed:



Prefix
Assessment Timing




m0
Screening survey


m1
Pre-exercise survey


m2
Post-exercise survey


m3
Follow-up survey


w01–w21
Weekly surveys (weeks 1-21)



Example: m1_birthyear = participant’s birthyear assessed in pre-exercise survey

title: ProPELL Survey Codebook
text:
Navigating This Codebook
Use the table of contents on the left to browse surveys by week and timing (online/lab). Each survey section includes:

Item-level documentation – Individual questions, response options, and descriptive statistics
Response distributions – Histograms and frequency tables
Summary statistics – Completion rates, means, medians, standard deviations
Source information – Project context, contact person, and references

title: ProPELL Codebook: Survey Data
text:
This codebook provides comprehensive documentation of all variables assessed across the 25 ProPELL surveys. All questionnaires were administered via LimeSurvey to 75 participants over a 21-week study period.



 📊 Survey Documentation

Browse all survey variables and metadata


 📈 Completion Overview

View participant completion status


 📥 Data Download

Access datasets on ProPELL Data Hub






The 25 ProPELL surveys are organized as follows:
Screening Survey: - s00 – Screening survey (online)
Study Surveys (Weeks 1-21): - Surveys collected both online (suffix: o) and on-site in the laboratory (suffix: l) - Example: s08o = Week 8 online; s12l = Week 12 on-site

Note: All participant IDs in the datasets are anonymized. The mapping between anonymous and pseudonymous IDs is available to authorized PIs only.




Variables are prefixed to indicate when they were assessed:



Prefix
Meaning




m0
Screening survey


m1
Pre-exercise survey


m2
Post-exercise survey


m3
Follow-up survey


w01–w21
Weekly surveys (weeks 1-21)



Example: m1_birthyear = participant’s birthyear assessed in pre-exercise survey




Browse Survey Documentation – Click on a survey to view all variables and their metadata
Variable Details – Each variable includes:

Item text/prompt
Response scale and possible values
Descriptive statistics and distribution plots
Data completeness information
Source and contact information

Search – Use the search feature to find specific variables by name or description





Study Duration: 21-week intensive longitudinal study
Participants: 75 participants (sport science students)
Data Collection: Online and on-site assessments
Variables: 800+ variables across 25 surveys


Questions? Contact: maik.bieleke@uni-konstanz.de
